schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: RustCrypto crates must move in lockstep (shared trait crates); update together
Group all GitHub Actions bumps into one PR
Automerge patch and digest bumps once CI is green

Cargo deps use caret ranges, so in-range minor and patch bumps are already applied to Cargo.lock by monthly lock file maintenance; skip the duplicate per-crate PRs. Out-of-range updates (major, including 0.x minor bumps) still get PRs, and security fixes from vulnerability alerts bypass this rule
